segments.name: TNMP
segments.description: Regulated electric transmission and distribution utility serving Texas communities.
segments.evidence: TNMP provides transmission and distribution services in Texas under the provisions of TECA and the Texas Public Utility Regulatory Act.

segments.name: PNM
segments.description: Regulated electric utility providing generation, transmission, and distribution service in New Mexico.
segments.evidence: PNM is an electric utility that provides electric generation, transmission, and distribution service to its rate-regulated customers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates for electric transmission, distribution and generation services; costs are recovered through general rate cases and rate riders.
revenueModel.evidence: Both PNM and TNMP seek cost recovery for their investments through general rate cases, periodic cost of service filings, and various rate riders.
